svg.title: Diagram delivery architecture
svg.desc: Editable Drawnix knowledge map of the diagram delivery architecture, preserving the Obsidian UI entrypoints, command dispatch, rendering pipeline, and CLI bridge as a document-rooted hierarchy with material cross-branch relations.
